supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends laterally beyond the orbital margins, creating a distinct shelf-like projection.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle and lower face exhibit significantly lighter pixel intensity (lighter pigmentation) compared to the dark, high-contrast periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip exhibits a thick vertical profile with a pronounced structural droop.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Light-colored patch/mark visible on the right side of the brow ridge; possible depigmented spots on the upper muzzle.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive cranial thinning/balding extending from the brow ridge to the posterior crown.
